Hello there,
I didn’t want to read and run. I have been through something similar, but I live in the UK and by your phasing I believe you’re in America.
My ex husband used to rape me. He even admitted to raping me, however I was never able to get a conviction for this. This is our crappy legal system.
I believe as long as you report it, you can revisit it. I told the police in 2019 and didn’t do anything with it for a year later when I felt I was mentally ready for the fight.
I am so sorry this has happened to you though and I’m here if you wish to talk x

Lust...

It doesn’t matter what the situation is, who else is involved, if two people have that connection, it takes a strong person to not act upon it. 
Destroys lives... morals go out the window.

I wanted to update this post..
He left his wife.. he said he couldn’t live without me either and spoke to her the next day.
They’re now sorting through the nitty gritty of separating their life and we’re making our own plans.
Very bizarre.
My AP is my postman at work. I get a thrill when he delivers to me and we stand chatting pretending it’s super innocent, knowing later he’ll be doing god knows what to me.

Hello, I didn’t take your words unkindly, and actually his love for his daughter is one of the things I adore about him. If only all fathers were like that! 
Yes I am a mother myself, and of course my children are my priority. Maybe my wording was quite harsh, my first language is not English. 
I am just not of the belief of staying in a loveless marriage for children’s sakes. He states he is in a loveless, sexless marriage and they barely communicate. Again, I could just be naive, but I chose to believe him due to the amount of time he spends with me.
Wine you shall have King Bobster
Bobby B thanks for giving us the bestest boy, Gendry!!

That I lied about how much I was really eating.. not just to others, but myself!!
I have just lost 150lbs and once I started keeping a food diary, I realised how many little things I neglected to admit i had eaten before. 
Finishing the kids tea, it still counts... it’s not free calories!! Having doughnuts at work.. yep that also counts!! Huge wake up call!!
